description: Readers A and B open with DAO shared read-only and keep a recordset; writer C attempts at three points: after both readers opened, after A closed while B remains, and after B closed. At each point C tries a DAO shared read/write open (then an Execute UPDATE on one row), a DAO exclusive open, and a native read/write share-zero CreateFileW. All results and timings are recorded.
retentionNote: Designed r-lock-1-2 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
